input: Get a dental cleaning and X-rays done

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this is for the user alone or also for family members changes the number of appointments to book and the coordination required.
Whether they already have a dentist or need to find a new one fundamentally changes the first steps of the plan.
A target date or deadline determines urgency and how quickly they need to act on booking.
Whether they have dental insurance affects which providers they can use and what out-of-pocket costs to plan for.
Knowing their scheduling constraints (weekdays, weekends, mornings, evenings) directly impacts which appointment slots are viable.
Understanding if there are any additional concerns beyond a routine cleaning and X-rays (e.g., pain, sensitivity) changes the type of appointment needed.
Knowing what is blocking them right now — procrastination, finding a provider, cost — clarifies where the plan needs to focus most.

gold.taskTitle: Get dental cleaning and X-rays done
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to schedule and complete a routine dental cleaning and X-rays appointment.

questions.title: Is this appointment just for you, or others too?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is booking for themselves only or also coordinating appointments for family members or dependents.

questions.title: Do you already have a dentist you go to?
questions.description: Establish whether the user has an existing dental provider or needs to research and select a new one.

questions.title: Do you have a target date to get this done by?
questions.description: Identify any deadline or preferred timeframe so the plan can reflect the appropriate level of urgency.

questions.title: Do you have dental insurance that will cover this?
questions.description: Clarify whether insurance is available, which affects provider selection and budget considerations.

questions.title: What days or times are you available for appointments?
questions.description: Understand the user's scheduling availability to identify realistic appointment windows to target.

questions.title: Are there any dental concerns beyond routine cleaning?
questions.description: Find out if the user has specific symptoms, pain, or issues that may require a different type of appointment or specialist.

questions.title: What has been the main thing stopping you so far?
questions.description: Identify the primary blocker — such as procrastination, cost, finding a provider, or anxiety — so the plan addresses the real obstacle first.
